title: Choose the visual world — VARSA
question: The roll assigned The Survey Sheet. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: The Survey Sheet
options.lineage: Survey of India two-colour lithographed topographic sheets
options.thesis: The monsoon record drawn as one survey sheet: every section registers to a graticule rail, and the 125-year departure ribbon is the mapped terrain.
options.viewport: Standard explorer shell — nav, cartouche title block carrying the live 2026 reading, Plate I (the departure ribbon) as the lead work area, a dense five-cell data strip beneath — all set in survey type with the graticule rail as the signature.
options.risk: Reads decorative-vintage if the linework is ornament instead of structure; the paper ground must stay stark, never cream-cosy.

raised.raise: Density courage: the data strip is a true hairline module grid, not airy stat cards.
One plot owns the field: Plate I's ribbon is the single monumental object of the first viewport.
State in line form: deficit and excess carried by line weight and dash on the ribbon, hue reserved for the fixed departure semantics.
Carbon-figure honesty: observed figures render filled, pipeline figures printed — provenance legible in the type itself.

options.label: Monsoon Water
options.lineage: river-gauge hydrometry and flood-season station logs
options.thesis: The page IS monsoon water: every number is a water level against a graduated staff gauge, and the 2026 deficit is the current reading.
options.viewport: Explorer shell whose hero band is a live staff gauge — 2026's level (759.4 mm, amber fill) against the 888 mm normal line — with a station-log grid of the headline findings beneath.
options.risk: Dark data-dashboards are the familiar rendition of this category; the gauge framing must stay literal to avoid becoming another dark analytics theme.

options.label: The Dense Sheet
options.lineage: Japanese high-density web — boxed modules, hairlines, utility-red tabs
options.thesis: All 36 subdivisions as a ruled module mosaic: every statistic on one screen, nothing wastes a pixel.
options.viewport: Statistics tab grid: live reading, three verdict modules, a 36-cell subdivision mosaic, and the full departure ribbon as one ruled band.
options.case: Faculty read dense statistical tables natively; density is the audience's own language, and the 36-cell mosaic makes the regional contrast physical.
options.risk: Reads cramped or retro-novelty if the grid loosens; colour must stay semantic.

options.label: The Catalog Sleeve
options.lineage: Factory-records catalogue identity — matte black, one white-line plot, coded colour strips
options.thesis: Matte black, one white-line pulse of 125 monsoon years owning the entire field, years as catalogue codes.
options.viewport: A single monumental pulse plot of the departure series with a decoded colour strip and four catalogue data lines — nothing else.
options.case: The null-trend story reads instantly as one object of great calm authority; the strongest possible first impression of the record itself.
options.risk: Mutes the regional-departure story and the atlas' colour semantics; exploration lives entirely one level down.

options.label: The Region Lobes
options.lineage: zoo and gardens guide maps — flat swelling lobes of colour
options.thesis: Rainfall regions as flat colour lobes with the coastline doing the dividing.
options.viewport: Region lobes swelling across the frame, capsules pinning key readings.
options.case: Regional maps are native to the subject, but playful lobes undercut the data-honesty commitment and collide with the fixed departure palette.
options.kept: Region borders as drawn structure — the atlas already owns this job better.

options.label: The Stamp Grid
options.lineage: doujin event catalogs — thousands of postage-stamp thumbnails
options.thesis: Every year a stamp in a numbered grid, the reader circling deficit years by hand.
options.viewport: 125 tiny year-stamps packed edge to edge with a biro route.
options.case: Charming, but convention-culture identification is thin for this audience and 125 identical stamps hide the magnitude story.
options.kept: The marked route — a hand-drawn selection path over a dense grid.

options.label: The Ticket Wallet
options.lineage: jet-age airline ticket wallets — carbon coupons and route arcs
options.thesis: 125 years bound as a coupon book; each era tears off in sequence.
options.viewport: The wallet open on the current leg: 2026's coupon.
options.case: A journey metaphor fights a data explorer where there is no journey — the record is one standing object, not a sequence of legs.
options.kept: Carbon-figure honesty — filled figures for observed data vs printed for generated, adopted as a raise on the assigned direction.

options.label: The Emission Rail
options.lineage: spectrogram plates on a viewing box — hairline emission lines on charcoal
options.thesis: The record as an emission-line spectrum; state carried in line height, dash and doubling.
options.viewport: One off-centre rail of hairline marks, the open year blooming into a plate above.
options.case: Instrument-beautiful, but spectroscopy identification is thin for this audience — and the world borrows from the very instruments the mode rules fence off.
options.kept: State in line form (dash, height, doubling, not hue) — adopted as a raise on the assigned direction.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: The dark analytics dashboard this category ships, executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: The arrangement a visitor expects — hero, KPI cards, chart panels — at full craft.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every other data site by design; the incumbent look, played straight.
